extracted.intended_audience: European Commission services preparing initiatives and stakeholders responding to EU public consultations
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for designing, conducting and responding to EU public consultations (Call for Evidence), aimed at Commission services running consultations and stakeholders submitting responses. Covers principles for stakeholder engagement, consultation tools, and quality indicators for effective responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure wide participation throughout the policy cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission should ensure wide participation throughout the policy cycle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation should be sought at all relevant stages of preparing new initiatives, proposals, or evaluations of existing legislation; use a mix of tools to reach broad audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek and consider a wide range of views and input
rubrics_metrics.description: The Commission should seek and consider a wide range of views and input.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively solicit diverse perspectives and ensure they are taken into account in policy development and decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure all relevant parties have the opportunity to express their opinions
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure that all relevant parties have had the opportunity to express their opinions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design consultations so that stakeholders with relevant interests and expertise can contribute, including targeted outreach where needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use web-based public consultations together with targeted consultations
rubrics_metrics.description: Use web-based public consultations together with targeted consultations as key elements of strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine open, web-based calls with focused dialogues (targeted consultations) to balance inclusiveness and depth of input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to the scope of the consultation
rubrics_metrics.description: EU consultation quality assessment looks for relevance to the scope of the consultation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responses should address the issues and boundaries defined by the consultation; off-topic or tangential submissions are less useful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive engagement with the questions posed
rubrics_metrics.description: EU consultation quality assessment looks for substantive engagement with the questions posed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respondents should answer the consultation questions directly and provide considered argumentation rather than generic statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence-based reasoning
rubrics_metrics.description: EU consultation quality assessment looks for evidence-based reasoning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support positions with data, references, case studies, or other factual evidence; explain the quality and limits of the evidence provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stakeholder identity transparency (Transparency Register)
rubrics_metrics.description: EU consultation quality assessment looks for stakeholder identity transparency (in the Transparency Register).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare stakeholder identity and, where applicable, register details so that contributions can be assessed in light of interests and representativeness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear positioning on the policy options presented
rubrics_metrics.description: EU consultation quality assessment looks for clear positioning on the policy options presented.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State clearly which option(s) you support or oppose and explain why, linking reasoning to objectives and evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed alternative options where relevant
rubrics_metrics.description: EU consultation quality assessment looks for proposed alternative options where relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When existing options are insufficient, suggest feasible alternatives and describe their expected impacts and trade-offs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call for Evidence (consolidated consultation approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Call for Evidence (CFE) replaced Inception Impact Assessments and Evaluation Roadmaps and consolidated all public consultations into a single call.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the CFE to provide flexibility in organising consultation activities and to reduce consultation fatigue; design CFEs to be comprehensive yet targeted where necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool #51: Consulting stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool #51 in the toolbox: Consulting stakeholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical guidance element focused on how to engage with stakeholders; use in conjunction with strategy and conducting tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool #52: Consultation strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool #52 in the toolbox: Consultation strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on designing an overall consultation strategy, selecting target groups, timelines and methods to achieve meaningful engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool #53: Conducting consultation activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool #53 in the toolbox: Conducting consultation activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational guidance for running consultation events, collecting submissions, facilitating participation and ensuring accessibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool #54: Analysing data and informing policymaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool #54 in the toolbox: Analysing data and informing policymaking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on analysing consultation inputs and integrating findings into policy development and impact assessment processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool #55: Horizontal matters (publication, data protection, access)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool #55 in the toolbox: Horizontal matters (publication of responses, data protection, access to documents, transparency register).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure compliance with rules on publishing responses, protecting personal data, handling access-to-documents requests, and applying Transparency Register requirements.
